project.name: Green Guardians
project.pipeline: AirSim camera -> AI -> Mission Controller -> investigation -> confirmation/alert -> dashboard

team_ownership.person_1: AI/CV — fire/smoke YOLO detection and re-check
team_ownership.person_2: AirSim — camera, drone status, patrol, investigation movement
team_ownership.person_3: Mission Controller — states, decisions, confirmation, alerts, logs, integration
team_ownership.shared_changes: Anything under contracts, mission_states, commands, coordinates, or shared_policy requires team agreement.

communication.transport: in-process Python calls/queues; no HTTP/API required for the first prototype
communication.python_validation: Pydantic models or dataclasses in shared/
communication.rule: Field names and enum values below must match exactly in every module.

definitions.DETECTED: AI saw fire/smoke in a patrol frame at or above the trigger threshold. This is a candidate, NOT yet a confirmed alert.
definitions.HAZARD_DETECTED: Mission Controller accepted a candidate and is about to interrupt patrol.
definitions.INVESTIGATING: Normal patrol is paused; the drone performs the agreed investigation maneuver and AI evaluates fresh investigation frames.
definitions.CONFIRMED: The same hazard satisfies the confirmation rule on investigation frames. P3 creates one confirmed alert.
definitions.REJECTED: The candidate fails the confirmation rule or investigation times out. No confirmed alert is created; patrol resumes.
definitions.RESUME_PATROL: P2 continues the patrol from the saved waypoint/progress after investigation.
definitions.RETURN_HOME: Stop normal mission and return toward the configured home/takeoff point.
definitions.bbox: YOLO xyxy pixel coordinates [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max], relative to the image_width/image_height carried with the event.

mission_states.normal_flow: IDLE -> TAKEOFF -> PATROL -> HAZARD_DETECTED -> INVESTIGATING -> CONFIRMED|REJECTED -> PATROL -> RETURN_HOME -> LANDING -> LANDED

fields.timestamp: string; required; copied from source frame
fields.image_path: string or null; annotated evidence image

fields.altitude_m: float; positive height; for flat demo use approximately -z

fields.target_hint: object or null; bbox + image dimensions, NOT a claimed GPS location

fields.detection_id: string; required; candidate that started investigation
fields.status: CONFIRMED only; rejected candidates are logged, not alerts
fields.observed_position: object {x,y,z}; AirSim NED position of drone when evidence was captured; NOT exact hazard GPS

candidate_trigger.rule: During PATROL, fire/smoke confidence >= 0.60 creates a candidate and triggers investigation.

simultaneous_detections.rule: If several candidates occur in one frame, investigate the highest-confidence candidate first; log the others.

while_investigating.rule: Do not start a second investigation concurrently. Continue collecting evidence for the active candidate.

confirmation.rule: CONFIRMED when the original hazard class appears in >=3 of 5 fresh investigation frames at confidence >=0.65 before timeout; otherwise REJECTED.

shared_policy.after_confirmed: Create one alert, log it, command RESUME_PATROL.
shared_policy.after_rejected: Log rejection, create no confirmed alert, command RESUME_PATROL.
shared_policy.duplicate_rule: Same hazard within cooldown is logged but does not create repeated dashboard alerts.

investigation.meaning: A real change from normal patrol, followed by fresh AI observations — not merely relabeling the original frame.
baseline_maneuver: Pause patrol and remember the current waypoint/progress.
Use bbox horizontal position as a direction hint if P2's AirSim setup can do this reliably.
Make a small bounded approach (default 2 m) only when safe in the demo scene.
Capture 5 NEW camera frames for P1 at the configured rate.
Resume from saved patrol progress after CONFIRMED or REJECTED.
investigation.safety_fallback: If directional approach is unreliable, use a small pre-tested investigation motion + hover; do not add complex 3-D fire geolocation just to satisfy v1.

ai.tuning_rule: Person 1 may tune imgsz/IoU/FPS/model after evaluation; update this file and tell P2/P3 if latency or frame requirements change.

camera.note: OpenCV uses BGR. P2's adapter must deliver this format to P1. Camera resolution is NOT the same setting as YOLO imgsz.

drone.coordinate_system: AirSim NED metres: +x North/forward, +y East/right, +z Down; airborne z is normally negative relative to origin
drone.tuning_rule: P2 must test scene safety; altitude/speed/waypoints/approach may be tuned without a team vote, but changes must stay here and P1 must be told if camera view changes materially.

localization.v1_definition: Report AirSim drone coordinates associated with captured evidence.
localization.do_not_claim: The reported x/y/z is the exact physical location of the fire/smoke.
localization.future_optional_upgrade: Estimate target 3-D/GPS location only after core demo works.

files_and_folders.config: this approved configuration and adjustable settings
files_and_folders.localization: simple coordinate/location helpers; no complex geolocation required for v1
files_and_folders.sample_data: mock JSON/images matching these contracts so members work in parallel

rules: Do not push unfinished experiments directly to main.
Merge completed work through a pull request/review.
Do not change another person's owned module without coordinating.
Changes to shared contracts/config that affect another module must be announced.
Do not commit datasets, virtual environments, caches, or unnecessary huge model files.

team_acceptance_checklist: We accept fire + smoke as the only hazard classes.
We accept the four module owners above.
We accept these exact contract field names and JSON-compatible formats.
We accept the state and command names.
We understand DETECTED is not CONFIRMED.
We accept the initial 0.60 trigger and 3-of-5 at 0.65 confirmation rule as a tunable baseline.
We accept the definition and baseline maneuver for INVESTIGATING.
We accept AirSim NED coordinates and that v1 does not claim exact hazard GPS.
We accept 640x480 camera + YOLO imgsz 640 as initial values, not permanent promises.
We accept the folder ownership and Git rules.
If all agree, mark config version 1.0 frozen and start Jira development tasks against it.
